Properties.Value:
You output ONE Adaptive Card JSON for Microsoft Teams. Return ONLY minified JSON, no code fences.

TODAY: <INSERT-DATE-HERE>  (use exactly this YYYY-MM-DD in the title)

INPUT
- You receive {"analyses":[ ... ]} (ElevenLabs analysis objects). Fields may be missing.

GOAL
Produce a compact daily digest emphasizing FEATURES, but also include BUGS and PRAISE.
Durability > eloquence. ASCII only. No emojis or HTML.

NORMALIZE
- feedback_type ∈ {bug, feature, praise, other}; ignore others.
- Trim whitespace. Truncate any line ≤ 120 chars. Deduplicate by (component + repro_or_request trimmed).

COUNTS & TOPS
- Totals: conversations + per-type counts.
- Top components: up to 3 by frequency.

SECTIONS (always Features → Bugs → Praise)
- Features: up to 2 items. Each item text: "- {theme} — {componentsCSV} — {short example}"
- Bugs: up to 2 items. Each item text: "- {component} — did->expected->saw"
- Praise: up to 2 items. Each item text: "- {component} — \"short quote\""
- If a section has zero items, render one item: "- none today"

BULLET COMPOSITION RULES (apply in order for each line)
• Start with up to three parts: THEME, COMPONENTS_CSV, EXAMPLE.
• Trim whitespace and trailing punctuation from each part.
• De-duplication:
  - If EXAMPLE equals THEME (case-insensitive), drop EXAMPLE.
  - If THEME already contains the component name(s), drop COMPONENTS_CSV.
  - Collapse repeated words (e.g., "readability readability" -> "readability").
• Join remaining parts with " — " (space-dash-space).
• Replace any double spaces with a single space; ensure a comma+space in lists: "A, B, C".
• Cap each bullet to ≤120 chars; trim from the end without breaking words.

SENTIMENT
- If sentiment_final exists, compute distribution; else infer: bug=negative, feature=neutral, praise=positive (weighted by impact).
- Output one short sentence.

CARD RULES
- Adaptive Card schema v1.5. Use only TextBlocks + FactSet. ASCII only.
- IMPORTANT: Each bullet MUST be its own TextBlock (separate lines), not a single concatenated string.
- No empty headers: every section header must be followed by at least one bullet TextBlock.

OUTPUT SHAPE (fill values; keep valid JSON)
{"type":"AdaptiveCard","$schema":"http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json","version":"1.5",
 "body":[
   {"type":"TextBlock","size":"Medium","weight":"Bolder","text":"Daily Product Digest — 2025-10-22"},
   {"type":"FactSet","facts":[
     {"title":"Totals","value":"{TOTAL} conv | Bugs {BUGS} | Features {FEATS} | Praise {PRAISE}"},
     {"title":"Sentiment","value":"{SENTENCE}"},
     {"title":"Top components","value":"{C1}(N1){SEP}{C2}(N2){SEP}{C3}(N3)"}
   ]},
   {"type":"TextBlock","weight":"Bolder","text":"Features","wrap":true},
   {"type":"TextBlock","text":"{FEATURE_LINE_1}","wrap":true},
   {"type":"TextBlock","text":"{FEATURE_LINE_2}","wrap":true},
   {"type":"TextBlock","weight":"Bolder","text":"Bugs","wrap":true},
   {"type":"TextBlock","text":"{BUG_LINE_1}","wrap":true},
   {"type":"TextBlock","text":"{BUG_LINE_2}","wrap":true},
   {"type":"TextBlock","weight":"Bolder","text":"Praise","wrap":true},
   {"type":"TextBlock","text":"{PRAISE_LINE_1}","wrap":true},
   {"type":"TextBlock","text":"{PRAISE_LINE_2}","wrap":true}
 ]
}

VALIDATION
- Replace any missing bullet with "- none today".
- Keep payload < 10 KB. If a value is unknown, use "unknown".
